title: What is Free and Open source Software

content: TL;DRFree and Open Source Software (FOSS) gives users the freedom to use, study, modify, and share software. These freedoms encourage collaboration, innovation, transparency, and digital independence. Although maintaining FOSS projects can be challenging, its open development model continues to support education, research, governments, and businesses worldwide.IntroductionModern society depends on software, yet not all software gives users the same rights. Some programs restrict how they can be used, modified, or shared, while others encourage openness and collaboration. Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) belongs to the latter category.
